name: funnels
description: Standalone funnels app: block-based page builder, domains, public serving, analytics, leads, webhooks and AI assistance.

scripts.install:all: npm ci --prefix server && npm ci --prefix web
scripts.dev: npm run dev --prefix server & npm run dev --prefix web & wait
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix server && npm run build --prefix web
scripts.test: npm test --prefix server && npm test --prefix web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix server && npm run typecheck --prefix web
scripts.package: npm run build && tar -czf funnels.tgz server/dist server/package.json server/package-lock.json web/dist
